diagnostic_rgbd.reason: legacy Astra USB2 simultaneous 640x480 streams stall after first frame

marker_size_measurement.note: user reports ID0 is probably the only 75 mm marker

range_cross_check.note: single approximate range compared with a 300-frame live median; no scale applied

markers.reference_measurement_type: nearest black-square edge gaps, including nearest corners for diagonals; NOT center-to-center

reference_center_cross_check_mm.note: 2026-09-30 user measurement; approximate ruler values, not a live camera reprojection check

reference_fit.method: equal-weight nonlinear least squares of shortest gaps between axis-aligned black marker squares; ID0 origin; ID1 on +X; ID0 size 75 mm, others assumed 70 mm
reference_fit.note: legacy fit treated black-square edge gaps as center distances and is invalid

pickup_roi_table_mm.note: Conservative bounding box of legacy x=80..220/y=200..300 ROI transformed to corrected reference frame; camera-only and not revalidated live, does not authorize robot motion

pickup_candidate_filter.note: Whole-container bootstrap gate; rejects partial fragments and is not an identity classifier

depth_geometry_validation.reference_frame_note: Historic result used invalid legacy edge-gap-as-center scale; repeat before interpretation

transforms.convention: T_A_B transforms a point from frame B into frame A
transforms.world_axes: +X ID0 to ID1; +Y into the board; +Z above the board

motion_blocked_reasons: object marker roles are not defined
robot workspace limits are not defined
